description: This file defines the main administrative UI shell for a Flutter web app, including navigation, session management, and layout for various pages accessible within the admin panel.

classes.name: AdminPanelShell
classes.description: Main widget providing the admin interface shell with a sidebar, topbar, and content area, managing navigation and authentication state.

classes.name: _AdminSideBar
classes.description: Sidebar widget with navigation items and sign-out button.

classes.name: _TopSearchField
classes.description: Search input field in the topbar.

classes.name: _UserChip
classes.description: Displays user info and avatar in the topbar.

methods.name: _checkSession
methods.description: Checks if the user session is valid by reading tokens, updates authentication state.

methods.name: _signout
methods.description: Logs out the user, updates state, and navigates to login page.
